name: In Search of Menara Voidrender

meta.next: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe

summary: An Alliance warlock is sent across the Great Sea to seek Menara Voidrender. From a tower above Ratchet, she trains warlocks of every faction in binding and artifact making.

sections.title: A Reluctant Recommendation
sections.body: Beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind, Demisette Cloyce trains warlocks with strict standards. When a student is ready to make powerful items, Demisette seldom believes they are prepared. Yet the cabal's higher authorities order the student onward, far from the capital, to prove their mettle.

sections.title: The Tower Above Ratchet
sections.body: Menara Voidrender keeps her laboratory in a stone tower above Ratchet, the goblin port in the arid hills of the Barrens. There she takes apprentices of every race and allegiance, beyond Stormwind's laws and Orgrimmar's watch. The fiends and demons warlocks face bear the same malice toward every mortal soul.

faq.q: Why is an Alliance warlock sent all the way to the Barrens?
faq.answer: Few Alliance warlocks have the knowledge or freedom to make advanced fel vestments such as the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe. Menara Voidrender's secluded tower above neutral Ratchet offers a rare place to study dangerous crafts beyond the reach of capital guards and inquisitors.

aliases: who starts in search of menara
faq.answer: Demisette Cloyce is a senior human warlock trainer who works beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. Stern and protective of dangerous knowledge, she sends students to Menara only when the unseen powers guiding the warlock enclave order her to do so.

faq.q: Does Menara Voidrender care about the Alliance or Horde conflict?
faq.answer: No. Menara teaches that warlocks must look beyond race and faction. The demons and otherworldly forces they summon are savage to all who falter, so shared survival and dark arts matter more than mortal wars.

faq.q: What item is Menara Voidrender preparing the warlock to make?
faq.answer: Reaching Menara is the first step toward turning the Robe of Arcana into the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe. The potent garment is made with rare reagents, fine tailoring and bound demonic energies.

faq.q: Is traveling to Ratchet dangerous for an Alliance warlock?
faq.answer: The Barrens is chiefly Horde territory, with hostile wildlife, centaur and orc patrols. Ratchet is a neutral port run by the Steamwheedle Cartel, so an Alliance traveler can reach Menara's tower by keeping to the coast or arriving safely by boat from Booty Bay.

faq.q: Why does Demisette Cloyce think the player isn't ready?
faq.answer: Demisette sees making fel-infused items of power as reckless for novices without experience. Warlock artifacts demand strict discipline. A small error in binding reagents or demonic essences can destroy the practitioner or loose horrors into the world.

angles.text: As a warlock, you cross from Stormwind's hidden warrens to Kalimdor's open frontier. The path teaches that the pursuit of demonic mastery crosses mortal factions.
As an Alliance caster, you leave familiar eastern lands for the untamed Barrens to find specialized instruction.
